story.heading: Built from a real need.
story.paragraph1: In 2019, a group of real estate professionals and software engineers came together to digitize the Argentine real estate market. We saw how much time, money, and stress it cost families to find their home.
story.paragraph2: Today we're a growing platform with a presence in Buenos Aires and local agents who know every neighborhood in depth.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To be the trusted partner for every family and investor searching for their next property in Buenos Aires.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To provide a clear, transparent, data-driven process that strengthens every real estate decision.

commitment.title: Our Commitment
commitment.desc: We focus on trust, hands-on support, and sustainable long-term results.
